module: ImGui panel of the "Fence" sub-tool of Easy Object Select. Lets you choose the fence mesh (Asset Browser selection or object selected in Easy Select), set the anchor matching distance (0.05 to 5 m) and the "No overlap" option, then start Select Fence, and, once the mode is active, confirm (Exit Fence Mode), cancel (Cancel Fence) or delete (Delete Fence) the fence. Delegates all the logic to fence/session.
notes: Exit Fence Mode and Delete Fence are disabled when the session has reached its safety limit (isCapped).
The panel state (chosen asset, distance, noOverlap, message) is local to the module.

drawWorkspace.desc: Draws the sub-tool panel and handles clicks on its buttons (calls fenceSession.begin / exitAndCommit / cancel / deleteAndCommit / setNoOverlap).

options.desc: canEnter (boolean): if false, Select Fence is disabled.

update.desc: Passes the frame to fenceSession.update (mouse/keyboard input, preview, drawing).

canAcceptInput.desc: true if the view can receive input.

returns.desc: true if a session is active.

cancel.desc: Cancels the current fence session (restores the original pieces).

isModeActive.desc: Indicates whether fence mode is active.

returns.desc: true if a session is active.
